compare.q: compare Dex Voice Lab and The Full Weasel
compare.a: Dex Voice Lab (Dex Systems, ground level) holds 5 projects — 3 active and 2 paused. Five voice projects, one requirement: recognition and synthesis run locally, and audio is not transmitted. The Full Weasel (Games & Play, ground level) holds one project, completed. Among seventy-three projects, this one is complete and playable. A hard deadline did what deadlines do. They are in different wings. They share no project family.
